{{nihongo|'''Mii Shrine'''|御井神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}{{ill|Yōrō District, Gifu|Q1155060|qid=Q1155060}}{{ill|Yōrō, Gifu|Q153814|qid=Q153814}}. It is the Mii Shrine of {{ill|Tagi district|Q11431050|qid=Q11431050}} in {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the former {{ill|Q712534|lt=shrine rank}} it was classified as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Mii Shrine'''|御井神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

The shrine grounds are shared with Kasuga Shrine. Although the precincts are the same, the {{ill|Torii|ar|توري|az|Torii|bcl|Torii|bg|Тории|ca|Torii|cs|Torii|de|Torii|el|Τορίι|eo|Torijo|es|Torii|et|Torii|eu|Torii|fa|توریئی|fi|Torii|fr|Torii|he|טוריאי|hu|Torii|hy|Տորիի|id|Torii|it|Torii|ja|鳥居|jv|Torii|ko|도리이|lt|Torii|ms|Torii|nl|Torii|no|Torii|oc|Torii|pl|Torii|pt|Torii|ru|Тории|simple|Torii|sl|Tori|sq|Torii|sv|Torii|ta|தொரீ|th|โทริอิ|tr|Torii|uk|Торії|uz|Torii|vi|Torii|wuu|鳥居|zh|鳥居|qid=Q234731}} gates for Mii Shrine and Kasuga Shrine are separate. Facing the shrine buildings, the right-hand side belongs to Mii Shrine.

== History ==
The date of establishment is unknown. The “Mino no Kuni Jinmyōchō” records the deity Mii-no-kami with the court rank of Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade. Originally, the shrine stood slightly east of its present location, and it is said that within the grounds there was a {{ill|Well|Q43483|qid=Q43483}} that never ran dry.

During the {{ill|Shōō (Kamakura period)|Q1327371|qid=Q1327371}} era of the {{ill|Kamakura period|Q236205|qid=Q236205}}, the shrine suffered severe damage due to flooding. It was rebuilt, but during the {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} era of the {{ill|Azuchi–Momoyama period|Q319531|qid=Q319531}}, it was destroyed by warfare and fell into decline.

After flooding in the {{ill|Shōhō|Q1146192|qid=Q1146192}} era of the early {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, the shrine was relocated to the grounds of the nearby Shinmei Shrine. Mii Shrine then became a subsidiary shrine within the precincts of Shinmei Shrine.

In the first year of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} ({{ill|1868|Q7717|qid=Q7717}}), Mii Shrine was designated the main shrine and Shinmei Shrine was changed to a subsidiary shrine. In Meiji 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was promoted to gōsha rank. In Meiji 14 ({{ill|1881|Q7808|qid=Q7808}}), it was relocated to the precincts of Kasuga Shrine (the present location).
